coverage: Read in full: the main text (intro and statement), Sec. 2 (duality, comparison rules, reference cost, free limits, coefficient gap, spin upper bound), Sec. 4 (the magnetic lower bound in full), Sec. 5 (openness in full), Sec. 6 (final identification), and the Sec. 3 statements plus the proofs of the mixed limits, pin interaction and restoration. Skimmed only: Sec. 3 band/path/cluster-moment lemmas and vanishing reach (lines 124-823). Checked by hand: the order and logic of the final contradiction argument; the spin upper exponent constants (per-annulus D = ∫|p|² = 2π log 2, two sources, λ = 1/a giving -2π/a, which is -1/4 at a = 8π); the direction of the tilted shifted/centered monotonicity used in release-of-constraints bounds; the face-ratio exponent 2 - a/(4π) (ΣD² = (1/2π) log G, odd-face variance a, even remainder's linear term vanishes by diagonal symmetry), giving the gap at 8π; the replica cumulant identity; the magnetic angular energy (1/2a)·4π log n; the filling-step inequalities; the restoration sandwich r_H ≤ r_Δ ≤ 1; the Gaussian E r_H = ∏√(1-s_j²); D ≥ 0 via characteristic-coefficient monotonicity; the strengthened-form limit a'^{-1} = a^{-1} + δ (ζ²t² = 1 normalization); the torus diagnostic direction (removing precision increases variance, while a = 0 forces torus variance to 0).
main_claim: For the nearest-neighbor XY model on Z² at the mass-defined critical b_c, the free-box infinite-volume correlation satisfies log C_{b_c}(n)/log n → -1/4. The proof shows a(b_c) = 8π: a(b_c) = 0 is ruled out by the vEL bound 1/(8n), a(b_c) > 8π is ruled out by openness, and the spin exponents are matched as 2π/a.
sibling_notes: This paper is the September 24 parent of the family-216 papers (BKT universality, critical spin field, log correction, center magnetization, essential singularity). Its coefficient-gap argument (face ratio G^{2-a/4π}) and replica ODE match what the rank-150 sibling checked. Sec. 3–4 (Bessel pin transfers, magnetic sector comparison) and Sec. 5 (openness via strengthened law) are the Bessel-specific inputs the October papers cite as companion C (a(b_c) = 8π). I found no gap in them at the level checked. The residuals are companion-B RG entry/map uniformity and the vanishing-reach exploration.
